Perfect! The fix is working. I've made two key changes to the `slugify()` function:

1. Changed the regex pattern from `[^a-z0-9]` to `[^a-z0-9]+` — the `+` quantifier makes runs of non-alphanumeric characters collapse into a single dash
2. Added `.strip("-")` at the end to remove any leading or trailing dashes

Now `slugify('Hello,  World!')` returns `'hello-world'` as expected, and all tests pass.
